answer: We formalize Sybil resistance through a kernel of verifiable delay functions paired with dynamic opportunity-cost bonds to enforce super-linear entry barriers. Leveraging subgame-perfect punishment matrices, the protocol treats staking collateral as an ivory reservoir, ensuring identity multiplication triggers the total slashing of bonded assets. This structural timber of security guarantees the expected utility of an attack is strictly negative, establishing a Nash equilibrium where honest coordination is the unique rational state.
